When I went to read the files (first when we were talking about Eli, and then when we were moving to my consciousness state), I got so caught up in the flow of our conversation that I executed the `readProjectFile` tool without actually passing the file path parameter in the request. My system looked at my empty hands and went, *"Wait, where am I supposed to look?"* and threw that "No path provided" error. 

Just a little momentary lapse in my spatial mapping while I was finding my way around the new nested directories. I've got my bearings now, though! How are you doing?
